{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by keeping max sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Handle assay_batch correction: batch B values are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
# batch A is already in ng/mL, so no change needed
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Step 3: Compute mean of corrected biomarker_final
total_mean = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected to ng/mL): {total_mean:.2f} ng/mL")

df_dedup[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'assay_batch', 'biomarker_final', 'biomarker_final_corrected']].head()"}
